dimensions.assessment: Affects brokers and participants involved in digital asset sales and decentralized financial transactions.
dimensions.evidence: nullifies requirements for persons effectuating decentralized financial (DeFi) transactions to report certain information regarding digital asset sales to the Internal Revenue Service (IRS)

dimensions.assessment: Eliminates a specific regulatory reporting requirement imposed on digital asset brokers.
dimensions.evidence: such rule shall have no force or effect

dimensions.assessment: Involves tax administration reporting compliance, though exact macroeconomic or revenue impacts are not quantified in the text.
dimensions.evidence: Gross Proceeds Reporting by Brokers That Regularly Provide Services Effectuating Digital Asset Sales

dimensions.assessment: Congressional disapproval under the Congressional Review Act to invalidate a single administrative agency rule.
dimensions.evidence: Congress disapproves the rule submitted by the Internal Revenue Service

dimensions.assessment: Permanent invalidation of the specified IRS rule.
dimensions.evidence: such rule shall have no force or effect

missing_information: Estimated tax compliance cost savings or revenue changes resulting from the rule's nullification
importance_detail.rationale: Enacted as public law to nullify an IRS rule regarding gross proceeds reporting by brokers effectuating digital asset sales.
